# Jobibi — Build Plan v0.2: Local-First BYO-Key

**Status: AUTHORIZED.** Drafted 2026-08-25 to define the 5-slice execution plan for Jobibi's transition to 100% open-source, local-first, BYO-Key architecture ([DECISIONS.md](../DECISIONS.md) D26).
Authorize slice by slice.

House rules carried into this project: vertical slices over layers (one feature end-to-end, verified running, then the next); commit after each green slice; fast unit tests for domain/pipeline logic, UI verified by running the extension; every slice carries an explicit not-in-scope list; one sentence per line repo style.

**Core Stack:** PGlite WASM (`@electric-sql/pglite` + `@electric-sql/pglite-pgvector`) in IndexedDB + in-browser ONNX `gte-small` embeddings (`@xenova/transformers`) + direct client AI provider callers (`gemini-2.5-flash` / `gpt-4o-mini`) hosted in a Chrome Offscreen Document.

---

## Slices

### S1. PGlite Engine, Offscreen Host & Auth Teardown

Host `PGliteStorageAdapter` in a dedicated Chrome offscreen document backed by IndexedDB (`idb://jobibi-local-memory`) per D26.3 and D26.5.
Establish typed message-passing RPC between side panel UI / content scripts ↔ background service worker ↔ offscreen document host.
Generate a synthetic local UUID on first launch and persist it in `chrome.storage.local` as `jobibi_local_user_id` (D26.4).
Invoke `navigator.storage.persist()` on database initialization to prevent browser storage eviction (D26.13).
Completely remove Supabase auth and cloud database dependencies: remove `@supabase/supabase-js`, delete `supabase.ts`, delete `SignIn.tsx`, delete `useSession.ts`, remove `callback/` entrypoint, remove `web_accessible_resources` for callback from `wxt.config.ts`, and replace all `supabase.from(...)` and `supabase.functions.invoke(...)` calls with message-passing calls to the offscreen PGlite host (D26.1, D26.2).
Remove `profiles` table dependencies and `is_beta_tester` checks across UI components (D26.8, D26.12).
Extension opens directly to onboarding on first launch without sign-in barriers.

**Done when:** Extension boots instantly with no login screen, PGlite initializes in IndexedDB, the synthetic local user ID is generated and persisted, and the side panel can read/write documents and Q&A records via message passing.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** In-browser ONNX embeddings (uses mock/stub vector for testing CRUD), client AI adapters, settings UI.

### S2. In-Browser Document Parsing & ONNX Embeddings

Integrate `@xenova/transformers` with the quantized `Xenova/gte-small` ONNX model running inside the offscreen document (D26.9).
Trigger background download of model weights upon extension installation and cache permanently in browser CacheStorage/IndexedDB without blocking user onboarding.
Implement client-side text extraction for uploaded resumes and documents: PDF via `unpdf`/`pdfjs-dist` and DOCX via `mammoth` (D26.10).
Wire `AddDocument.tsx` to send uploaded file buffers to the offscreen document, extract text, generate semantic chunks via `chunkText`, compute 384-dimensional vector embeddings, and store records in PGlite `documents` and `memory_chunks`.
Discard the original binary file immediately after text extraction (D26.10).
Surface a non-blocking preparation spinner only if the user uploads a document while the initial ONNX model download is still in flight.

**Done when:** Uploading a PDF or DOCX resume extracts text and produces 384-dimensional vector embeddings in PGlite with zero external network requests in <2 seconds (once model is cached).
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** Direct AI provider API calls, settings UI.

### S3. Multi-Provider Client AI Adapters

Define the `AIAdapter` interface in `packages/shared/src/ai/` supporting structured JSON outputs.
Implement `GeminiClientAdapter` calling Google Gemini API (`gemini-2.5-flash`) with native `responseMimeType: "application/json"` and `responseSchema` (D26.6).
Implement `OpenAIClientAdapter` calling OpenAI API (`gpt-4o-mini`) with strict `response_format: { type: "json_schema" }` (D26.6).
Port pipeline logic from Supabase Edge Functions to pure TypeScript functions in `packages/shared/src/pipeline/`: suggestion pipeline (`suggest`), gap question generator (`gap-answer`), cover letter generator (`draft-cover-letter`), and style profile distillation (`style-profile`) (D26.11).
Offscreen document orchestrates the suggestion pipeline: retrieve hybrid chunks from PGlite → evaluate relative gate (D10, D15) → draft answer + skeleton via configured `AIAdapter` → return structured copy card.

**Done when:** Suggestion and cover letter drafting execute end-to-end via the user's configured provider and key, returning schema-validated structured JSON output.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** Settings UI, quota teardown.

### S4. Settings, Key Management & Graceful Fallbacks

Build the Settings UI in `Settings.tsx`: provider selector (Google Gemini / OpenAI), API key input with password masking, and a "Test Connection" verification button (D26.6).
Persist selected provider and API keys securely in `chrome.storage.local` (D26.12).
Store user preferences (`output_length`: Short, Medium, Long) directly in `chrome.storage.local` without tier restrictions (D26.8, D26.12).
Update `SuggestCard.tsx` and `DraftCoverLetter.tsx` with graceful keyless handling: when no API key is configured, show a friendly inline prompt with clear instructions on obtaining a free Google Gemini key or OpenAI key (D26.7).
Keep all non-AI features (document upload, memory management, question extraction across adapters, pick-list handling D24, capture D12/D16, seen-before recall) fully operational without an API key (D26.7).

**Done when:** Users can configure, test, and switch API keys in Settings, and unconfigured users receive non-blocking, contextual guidance without broken UI states.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** Quota teardown, Chrome Web Store packaging.

### S5. Quota Teardown, Cleanup, E2E Verification & CWS Package

Remove all legacy SaaS quota infrastructure: delete `UsageQuotasView.tsx`, remove daily suggestion cap checks, remove daily cover letter cap checks, and remove `cover_letter_attempts` handling (D26.8).
Unlock Auto-Fill (the Insert button) as a first-class feature for all users while preserving safety gates (mapping confidence ≥ 0.75, salary/notice static refusal) (D26.8).
Delete the `supabase/` directory, `deno.json`, and `deno.lock` (D26.1).
Update `wxt.config.ts`: add `host_permissions` for `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/*`, `https://api.openai.com/*`, and `https://huggingface.co/*`; remove `web_accessible_resources` for the retired callback page (D26.1, D26.6).
Update "Export my data" and "Delete everything" in `AccountView.tsx` to operate directly on local PGlite tables.
Execute full automated test suite: unit tests in `packages/shared/`, component tests in `apps/extension/`, and Playwright E2E suite across JobStreet, LinkedIn, Indeed, and Generic ATS fixtures.
Build clean production distribution package for the Chrome Web Store.

**Done when:** All unit and E2E tests pass with zero errors, zero remote backend dependencies remain in the codebase, and `pnpm build` creates a valid production extension package.
⛔ **NOT in this slice:** Future ATS adapters (Workday), local LLM runtime (Ollama).
